notes: Corrected s001/s003: the accepted alignment gave on the to the article headed on the and first day to μιᾷ headed on first, which is rule 17's generic-noun clause. Rule 102 scopes that clause to anarthrous Greek and is unanimous the other way where a Greek article stands to take the determiner, so the article takes on the … day headed on day and the numeral keeps a bare first.
s006 ὄρθρου takes the supplied at because no Greek preposition is expressed and rule 21 forbids leaving it on an article the ASV gave no determiner.
LUK.24.7 and LUK.24.46 are not parallels for the corrected unit: there the noun ἡμέρᾳ is expressed, so the article takes only the.
